records.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: Vietnamese historical RTS map cutout sheet. Image 1 is the edit target and determines each object and its layout; image 2 is the drawing-style reference ONLY. Match the accepted Đông Hồ style: warm-black carved contours, large opaque ochre/vermilion/indigo/leaf-green pigment shapes, sparse curved decorative marks, no gradients, tiny hatching, photorealistic shading or engraved microtexture. Preserve the original silhouettes, identity and functional shapes. No labels, grid lines or scenery. Keep seven distinct mountain/ridge shapes in original order: broad karst range, soft low ridge, classic karst, three-spire, seven-spire, stepped karst, tower-form cluster from the reference; final two cells empty. Preserve peak counts and silhouettes. Use broad flat pale ochre/leaf-green rock faces, clear warm-black outer contours and very few curling rock strata. No hundreds of thin hatch strokes, forests, sky, mist or ground rectangles. Landscape 1536x1024, 3 columns by 3 rows, 7 occupied cells in reading order. At least 24 pixels of empty margin around each complete silhouette and wide gutters. Use genuine transparent alpha including every hole, without a painted checkerboard. If true alpha cannot be produced use one exact #FF00FF production matte instead, including holes. No paper rectangle, white background, cast shadows, or magenta inside subjects.
